subject: EU-only placement confirmation + DPA addendum and transient backup-hop questions
messages:
From: Sandra Park <sandra.park@medlyhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@datashield.eu>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: EU placement confirmation and DPA addendum request

Hi Olga / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are near contract finalization at Medly and need a few concrete items to move legal/infosec forward:

- Can Redwood confirm EU-only placement for production inference (data at rest + model KV cache) for our tenant, with no routine egress to US or other regions?
- We understand transient hops are possible for backups/replication during maintenance. Please detail the maximum duration of any temporary cross-region processing and the triggers that cause it.
- Please share the subprocessor roster and the proposed DPA addendum with explicit language about regional commitments and KMS key control.
- Evidence asked by our security team: sample telemetry showing regional egress paths and an example audit log entry indicating origin region.

We need answers in the next 3 business days to stay on the board for the June procurement window. Attaching an example compliance checklist for context.

Thanks,
Sandra
Sandra Park
Director, Security & Privacy
Medly Health
Attachment: medly-compliance-checklist.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Park <sandra.park@medlyhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU placement confirmation and DPA addendum request

Sandra — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; Karthik and I will follow up with the DPA language and telemetry snapshot.

- EU placement: We can confirm production inference and KV cache residency pinned to an EU region (typically eu-central-1 for Medly) by tenant. That means data at rest and short-lived in-memory KV cache will remain in region during normal processing.
- Transient hops: transient replication for backups or failover can route a copy to a neighboring region only under the following conditions: scheduled maintenance windows, infrastructure-wide failover, or explicit customer-approved failover. We cap transient cross-region retention to a maximum of 72 hours in the DPA addendum draft we plan to propose.
- KMS/keys: Customers can opt to bring their own KMS (BYOK). With BYOK the key material is customer-controlled and audit logs showing KMS use are retained for 12 months by default.
- Evidence / telemetry: attaching a one-page telemetry sample that maps request origin -> egress hops + a CSV of active subprocessors.

Next steps: I attached a DPA addendum draft (v2) with the 72-hour transient hop clause and the current subprocessor roster. Would you like us to prepare a DocuSign-ready version after you review?

Olga Petrov
Lead, Trust & Security (Redwood Inference)
Attachment: DPA_addendum_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 135KB)
Attachment: subprocessor_roster_may2027.csv (CSV, 28KB)
Attachment: regional-egress-telemetry-sample.txt (TXT, 12KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Park <sandra.park@medlyhealth.com>; Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:31:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU placement confirmation and DPA addendum request

On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 13:04 Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Transient hops: transient replication for backups or failover can route a copy to a neighboring region only under the following conditions: scheduled maintenance windows, infrastructure-wide failover, or explicit customer-approved failover. We cap transient cross-region retention to a maximum of 72 hours in the DPA addendum draft we plan to propose.

Sandra — quick follow-up questions from ops/architecture: 

1) Can you confirm whether Medly requires a strict guarantee that no token-level inference payloads will ever cross regions (i.e., zero transient egress for inference request/response traffic), or is the acceptance only for data at rest + cache? We commonly see customers accept inbound inference traffic routed to EU but allow ephemeral replication for backups.

2) For the 72-hour transient retention: do you want us to define a shorter SLT for maintenance-driven hops (e.g., 6 hours) and a separate longer SLA for failover events? We can add a tiered carve-out in the addendum if that helps procurement.

3) If Medly chooses BYOK, we will include the KMS key control language and a process for key rotation and emergency key escrow. Do you have a preferred KMS provider?

4) Finally, for telemetry we can provide a redacted 7-day sample or a single-day detailed trace. Which is more useful for your security reviewers?

If you prefer, Olga and I can jump on a 20-minute call to resolve the carve-outs quickly.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Security (Redwood Inference)

From: Sandra Park <sandra.park@medlyhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@datashield.eu>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU placement confirmation and DPA addendum request

Thanks, Olga and Karthik — this is helpful. A few decisions from our security/compliance team: 

- Medly requires that inference request/response traffic for production must not be routed out of the EU in normal operation. Transient replication for backups is permitted under the maintenance/failover conditions you listed, but we want the maintenance window cap to be split: maintenance hops <= 8 hours; failover hops <= 72 hours and only with explicit post-facto notification to Medly. Please add those thresholds to the addendum.
- BYOK: we'll plan to use Azure Key Vault. Please include BYOK integration notes and the emergency-escrow procedure.
- Telemetry: a 24-hour detailed trace (redacted) is sufficient for our reviewers.

Can you turn the attached DPA addendum into a DocuSign-ready file with our requested thresholds and a short summary of the evidence you can provide? We aim to finish review and sign-off by Friday.

Best,
Sandra
Attachment: medly-security-request-summary.docx (DOCX, 32KB)
